decision agrees (trim before compare; RFC 9110 5.5 OWS is not part of a field value); expected output value '"x"<HTAB>' keeps a trailing HTAB, which RFC 9110 5.5 excludes ("A field value does not include leading or trailing whitespace"; parsers MUST exclude it). Basis for byte-for-byte copy is an unmarked contract sentence (Output). See contract-findings F2
RFC 9110 8.8.3 grammar: opaque-tag = DQUOTE *etagc DQUOTE (zero etagc allowed)

RFC 9111 4.3.4 bullet 2 + LC1 (Last-Modified weak; exact-octet equality after trim); recency per F5
RFC 9111 4.3.4 bullet 2 + LC1; trimming before compare matches RFC 9110 5.5 (OWS not part of value); output takes the 304 value
LC2 (every validator the 304 carries must correspond). RFC 9111 4.3.4 bullet 2 leaves "correspond" undefined; LC2 is a marked convention, load-bearing (contract-findings F7)
LC3 (tie at largest received -> refusal). RFC 9111 4.3.4 bullet 2 names a single "most recent" and defines no tie rule
LC3 (refuse only at the top tie) + RFC 9111 4.3.4 bullet 2 (single most recent identified); recency per F5
LC2 (stored response must carry each validator the 304 carries) + RFC 9111 4.3.4 bullet 2
RFC 9111 4.3.4 bullet 2 does not define "most recent"; receipt order (larger = more recent) is an UNMARKED Input definition (contract-findings F5); result follows only from that reading
RFC 9111 4.3.4 bullet 3 (304 carries no validator; the single initial-set response has none -> identified); 3.2 update

RFC 9111 4.3.4 bullet 3: no single stored response, so nothing is identified
